rationale.intuition: Test-optional 在 T20 显著 penalty (Common App data: highly-selective test-optional admit no-score 比 test-submitter 低 5-10pp)。Engine 应给 ~0.85× test penalty + reach tier。Confidence ≤ medium 反映 test signal 缺失。

sources.name: Common App Test-Optional Report 2024
sources.evidence: T20 schools admit no-score applicants at 60-75% of test-submitter rate (5-10pp absolute gap)

sources.name: Penn CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Test-optional accepted but published admit rate gap for no-score ~7pp

sources.name: Counselor Engine testBandMultiplier
sources.evidence: applyingTestOptional=true at <20% accept schools gets ×0.85 modifier
